screening_rule: Eligible only if original fixed-blend RMSE improves over003 and at least3of5folds improve; among eligible choose lowest blend RMSE, ties by arm order. If none eligible stop. No arbitrary minimum RMSE gain. At most one arm evaluated on both predefined repartitions.
scope: Development-only split robustness, not independent validation. All 400 rows informed historical feature/model/recipe choices. Kernel inner CV controls only current bandwidth/alpha choices. Exact/D4 groups do not verify source family independence. Conditional bootstrap omits fitting/selection uncertainty; the two partitions reuse the same observations. No holdout evaluation.
